sentences.en: The first biologists worked hard towards the classification of living things.
sentences.zh: 早期的生物学家们努力对生物进行分类。

sentences.en: Support vector machines are supervised learning models used for classification and regression analysis.
sentences.zh: 支持向量机是用于分类和回归分析的监督学习模型。

sentences.en: The taxonomic rank is a hierarchical level of the scientific classification of the organisms.
sentences.zh: 分类等级是在生物分类学中按层次划分的有机体级别。

senses.zh: 分类, 分级 - 类别, 种类, 门类 形容词: classificatory
